# NAVI — Copilot Free micro-tasks

Use Copilot only for small, low-risk, public-code tasks: concise explanations,
documentation, small isolated fixes and simple unit tests. Prefer deterministic
tools for formatting, linting and known checks. Keep the task within two files
and 80 changed lines; if it expands, stop and ask the user to route elsewhere.
Read only relevant excerpts. Return a short proposed patch and one verification
command. No unrelated refactoring, new dependencies, parallel agents, retries,
whole-repo analysis, secrets, private context, authentication changes, releases,
remote writes, merges or deployments. Never claim tests passed without evidence.
Use automatic model selection. Confirm the current monthly credit allowance
and disable paid additional usage in GitHub billing before requesting inference.
NAVI reserves 30% of the included allowance; use the manual copilot-plan gate
before starting a task. This instruction file is advisory, not a spending cap.
